# @example/streams

The TypeScript client for the Streams API (`example.streams#Streams`, API version `1`, sent as `Crucible-Version: 1` on every request), generated by [Crucible](https://github.com/Operation-Leyline/crucible) from the service's model.

## Install

```sh
npm install @example/streams@0.0.0
```

The package is `@example/streams`, version `0.0.0`; code refers to it as `@example/streams`.

## Create a client

```ts
import { StreamsClient } from "@example/streams";
import type * as models from "@example/streams";

const client = new StreamsClient({ endpoint: process.env.STREAMS_ENDPOINT });
```

The service declares no authentication. `endpoint` is the service's base URL. The client sends `Crucible-Version: 1` on every request.

## Call an operation

`publish` calls `Publish`. Every operation has a method like it.

```ts
import { StreamsClient, ValidationError } from "@example/streams";
import type * as models from "@example/streams";

// The client sends Crucible-Version: 1 on every request.
const client = new StreamsClient({ endpoint: process.env.STREAMS_ENDPOINT });

// Sample values generated from the model's types and constraints.
const input: models.PublishInput = {
  topic: "topic",
};

try {
  const events = await client.publish(input);
  for await (const event of events) {
    console.log(event);
  }
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof ValidationError) {
    console.error(`ValidationError (HTTP ${error.$metadata.status}):`, error.message);
  } else {
    throw error;
  }
}
```

## Errors

Each modelled error is a class exported from the package, extending `StreamsException` and `ServiceError`: test it with `instanceof` and read its fields and `$metadata.status`. Transport failures throw `NetworkError`; an exhausted `timeoutMs` throws `TimeoutError`.

## Retries and idempotency

Calls are retried with backoff when a retry is safe: a modelled throttling error is retried for any operation; transport failures, HTTP 500, 502, 503 and 504 and other retryable modelled errors only for operations that are read-only, idempotent or carry an idempotency token. For operations that declare an idempotency token, an unset token is generated once per call and reused on every attempt; set it yourself to replay one logical request across calls. Set `retry: { maxAttempts }` in the client configuration to change the attempt limit (3, the first included), or `retry: false` to turn retries off.
